documents.title: Embedded Image Field Note
documents.markdown:
# Embedded Image Field Note

NORTH PINE marks the opening observation.

The embedded diagram shows a blue river between two green banks.

CENTER RIVER confirms the image position.

SOUTH STONE closes the field note.

documents.title: Campus Garden Checklist
documents.markdown:
# Campus Garden Checklist

NORTH GATE begins the inspection.

- Check the soil
- Count the seedlings
  1. Record the east bed

| Plot | Seedlings |
| --- | --- |
| East | 12 |
| West | 9 |

CENTER BED confirms the table location.

SOUTH BENCH ends the inspection.

documents.title: Link and Code Route
documents.markdown:
# Link and Code Route

NORTH LAMP opens the route.

Read the [visible route guide](https://example.invalid/route).

```go
route := "CENTER ARCH"
fmt.Println(route)
```

SOUTH CLOCK closes the route.

documents.title: Two Column Reading Order
documents.markdown:
# Two Column Reading Order

NORTH STAR starts the left column.

Left note one comes before left note two.

CENTER BRIDGE ends the left column.

Right note one starts the second column.

SOUTH HARBOR ends the right column.
